## Summary
- keep the Sepo drawer enabled when Discussion IDs are missing or Discussions are disabled
- make Discussion repo/category IDs optional in the Quartz comments component
- update the discussion-ID resolver and workflow comments to treat Discussion lookup as optional for the drawer
- document Issues/Pulls-only drawer configuration

## Validation
- `npm run check`
- `npm test`

Note: per request, I did not wait on a full local build before pushing.

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #38 makes the Sepo drawer usable when GitHub Discussions are disabled or Discussion IDs cannot be resolved. It changes Discussion repo/category IDs from required Quartz inputs to optional ones, updates the resolver action and workflow comments, and documents Issues/Pulls-only setup. The intended outcome is that a minimal `SEPO_COMMENTS_REPO` setup can still render useful Issues and Pull requests tabs. No parent or tracking issue was referenced in the current PR body or comments.

## Review
The overall direction is sound, and the rubric review found the scoped contract/documentation changes acceptable. However, the default no-Discussion path still sends `discussions` as the first enabled tab, which currently opens the drawer on a broken/loading Comments view instead of Issues/Pulls.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Missing Discussion IDs leave Discussions selected | BLOCKING | `quartz.ts` warns when Discussion config is incomplete, but still passes `tabs=["discussions","issues","pulls"]` through to the embed. The live widget currently chooses `defaultTab:"discussions"` for that query with empty IDs, so the documented minimal setup does not deliver the intended Issues/Pulls experience. |
| Optional-ID path lacks regression coverage | WARNING | The existing checks passed, but reviewers found no focused coverage for `SEPO_COMMENTS_REPO` set with Discussion IDs absent. A targeted fixture/test would lock the new optional-ID behavior and catch the default-tab regression. |

## Progress
- Considered all reviewer outputs found under `/Users/shannons/clawd/self-evolving-local-runner/runner-2/_work/_temp/reviews`: rubrics, Claude, and Codex.
- Current PR conversation had no prior inline comments or review threads before this synthesis run.
- Posted one new inline comment on `quartz.ts` line 133: https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-template/pull/38#discussion_r3410059256
- No comments were minimized, no replies were added, and no threads were resolved.
- Reviewer validation reported `npm run check` and `npm test` passing; the blocker is about the no-Discussion default runtime configuration.

## Issue Details
<details>
<summary>Missing Discussion IDs leave Discussions selected</summary>

**Cause:** [`quartz.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-template/blob/1fedffc9fd613265891336fb20ded6c06fefab95/quartz.ts#L122-L138) computes `tabs` before `hasDiscussionConfig` and only warns when IDs are missing. The unchanged `tabs` array is then passed into the component, so the embed emits `data-tabs="discussions,issues,pulls"` without `repoId`/`categoryId`.

**Candidate solutions:** Derive an effective tab list after `hasDiscussionConfig`; remove `discussions` when IDs are absent, then compute/validate `defaultTab` from that filtered list. If the user explicitly requests only `discussions` without IDs, fail or disable according to the strict/best-effort policy instead of rendering an empty drawer.

**Comments:** Rubrics passed because an explicit `SEPO_COMMENTS_TABS=issues,pulls` setup works. The blocker is the documented minimal/default setup, where the service still opens on Discussions first.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Optional-ID path lacks regression coverage</summary>

**Cause:** The test suite does not appear to exercise the generated `.sepo-embed` config for the new “repo set, Discussion IDs absent” path.

**Candidate solutions:** Add a focused test or build fixture asserting that missing Discussion IDs do not emit an effective Discussions tab/default tab, while Issues/Pulls remain available. Also cover the explicit `SEPO_COMMENTS_TABS=discussions` missing-ID case if the fix chooses fail/disable semantics.

**Comments:** This is secondary to the behavior fix, but it is directly tied to the new optional-ID contract.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: The unresolved default-tab behavior requires a concrete branch change and is safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
NEEDS_REWORK

## Action Items
- [ ] Filter `discussions` out of the effective tabs when Discussion IDs are missing, and recompute/validate `defaultTab` from the filtered tabs.
- [ ] Add focused regression coverage for the missing-Discussion-IDs path, including the explicit discussions-only edge case.

---

Addressed the follow-up review in additive commit `97e5988` (no force push).

Changes:
- derive an effective Sepo drawer tab list after checking whether Discussion IDs are configured
- remove `discussions` from default tabs when IDs are absent, so minimal `SEPO_COMMENTS_REPO` starts with Issues/Pulls instead of a broken Discussions tab
- disable/fail via the existing best-effort vs `SEPO_COMMENTS_ENABLED=true` policy when the effective tab list would be empty or an explicit default tab is no longer valid
- added focused regression tests for missing-ID defaults, explicit Issues/Pulls, explicit discussions-only, explicit default-tab conflict, and PR preview defaulting to Pulls
- updated README to describe effective tab filtering

Validation:
- `npm run check`
- `npm test`

I did not run a full local build per the earlier request to skip direct builds.
